inlines.text: Andy Jassy 已经
公开表示
，他相信 AWS 能成为一项年收入达万亿美元的业务。在周四亚马逊的季度财报电话会议上，他重申了这一雄心。

blocks.text: “我们在亚马逊打造的东西是前所未有的。历史上从来没有一家企业做到过一万亿美元的年度营收，”他说。

inlines.text: “我们在亚马逊打造的东西是前所未有的。历史上从来没有一家企业做到过一万亿美元的年度营收，”他说。

blocks.text: 不过，在云业务达到那一步之前，亚马逊需要加大资本支出，建设支撑这项蓬勃业务所需的基础设施。

inlines.text: 不过，在云业务达到那一步之前，亚马逊需要加大资本支出，建设支撑这项蓬勃业务所需的基础设施。

blocks.text: “我们仍预计 2026 年的现金资本支出约为 2200 亿美元——其中大部分用于 AWS——并预计 2027 年的支出会明显更多，而且我们清楚地看到这些投入能带来财务回报，”Jassy 周四透露。

inlines.text: “我们仍预计 2026 年的现金资本支出约为 2200 亿美元——其中大部分用于 AWS——并预计 2027 年的支出会明显更多，而且我们清楚地看到这些投入能带来财务回报，”Jassy 周四透露。

blocks.text: 亚马逊在 AI 基础设施上的巨额投入，今年一直是投资者担忧的来源。在周四的电话会议上，华尔街分析师确实反复要求 Jassy 解释这些支出、增长真的会到来的信号，以及预期的利润率。

blocks.text: Jassy 告诉他们，这些钱都花得值，因为这家电商巨头计划抓住由 AI 驱动的全球云需求的历史性时刻。AWS 收入同比增长 39%，这已是连续第六个季度保持稳步增长。

blocks.text: 这位 CEO 在电话会议上预测，不仅明年会增长 40%，2028 年也会如此。

inlines.text: 这位 CEO 在电话会议上预测，不仅明年会增长 40%，2028 年也会如此。

blocks.text: “AWS 是一项年化收入运行率达到 1840 亿美元的业务，但机会依然非同寻常，”这位 CEO 兴奋地说。“凭借我们持续的创新步伐、新的核心功能和 AI 功能、企业希望在 AWS 上运行其核心和 AI 工作负载，以及我们每年新增的容量，我们相信 AWS 在 2027 年和 2028 年都能增长 40% 以上，并在未来五到十年内成为一项万亿美元收入的业务。”

blocks.text: Jassy 还补充说，企业采用 AI 仍处于“非常早期的阶段”，并表示到目前为止，“这一战略正在奏效”。

blocks.text: Andy Jassy has made it known that he believes AWS can be a trillion-dollar revenue business. During Amazon’s quarterly earnings call on Thursday, he repeated this ambition.

blocks.text: “What we’re building at Amazon is unlike anything that’s ever been seen before. There has never been a business with a trillion dollars of annual revenue,” he said.

inlines.text: “What we’re building at Amazon is unlike anything that’s ever been seen before. There has never been a business with a trillion dollars of annual revenue,” he said.

blocks.text: However, before the cloud business gets there, Amazon is going to have ramp up its capital expenditures to build out the infrastructure necessary to support that blossoming business.

blocks.text: “We still expect 2026 cash capex of approximately $220 billion — the majority for AWS — and expect to spend meaningfully more in 2027, with a clear line of sight to attract its financial returns,” Jassy revealed on Thursday.

blocks.text: Amazon’s big spending on its AI infrastructure buildout has been an ongoing source of concern for investors this year. Indeed, during Thursday’s call, Wall Street analysts repeatedly asked Jassy to explain the spending, the signals that the growth really will come, and the profit margins expected.

blocks.text: “AWS is a $184 billion annualized revenue run-rate business, and yet the opportunity remains extraordinary,” the CEO enthused. “With our continued pace of innovation, new core and AI functionality, enterprises wanting to run their core and AI workloads in AWS, and the amount of capacity that we’re adding each year, we believe that AWS can grow north of 40 percent in each 2027 and in 2028, and be a trillion-dollar revenue business in the next five to 10 years.”

blocks.text: The AI boom has been a mixed blessing for the cloud industry, since the AI services that undergird the boom are supported by cloud infrastructure. Like Amazon, other cloud providers are spending big but also earning big. Microsoft, for instance, just posted yet more record-breaking revenue growth, driven largely by its cloud business. It, too, has spent a bundle.
